process.title: Valuation Process
process.click_to_view: Click to view details of this step.
process.cta_desc: Our team of experts is always ready to advise and provide you with the best services.
process.meta_desc: Professional, transparent and optimized valuation process at MHD Valuation, helping customers receive results quickly and accurately.

step_1.title: Determine general assets and value
step_1.description: An important initial step to establish the legal foundation and valuation basis.
details: Determine basic legal, economic - technical characteristics of the asset.
Identify the user of the valuation results.
Determine the purpose and time of valuation.
Determine the value basis of the valuation.
Identify assumptions and special assumptions.

step_2.title: Make a valuation plan
step_2.description: To clearly determine the scope and progress of each work content scientifically.
details: Determine goals, requirements, scope and content.
Determine methods and procedures to proceed.
Determine necessary data, reliable document sources.
Build implementation schedule, human resource organization.
Determine whether to hire consultants (if any).

step_3.title: Field survey, information collection
step_3.description: The team of experts goes directly to the site to assess the actual condition of the asset.
details: Check the actual condition of the asset against the legal dossier.
Record factors directly affecting the asset value.
Collect market data, transaction prices of similar assets.
Study related macro and micro economic factors.

step_4.title: Information analysis
step_4.description: Use in-depth financial tools to assess and quantify risks.
details: Analyze the legality and planning of the asset.
Analyze the highest and best economic use.
Evaluate and process data collected from the market.
Select the most appropriate valuation method.

step_5.title: Determine value and make report
step_5.description: Complete dossiers, certificates and transparently transfer results to customers.
details: Run calculation models to produce estimated value results.
Prepare detailed, logical and strict valuation reports.
Internal quality control before issuance.
Issue official Valuation Certificates to customers.
